source_message.text:
The strongest option I found is Stripe Atlas, which would establish the business through Canada, but it brings setup costs, delays, and tax hassles. Whether to proceed is less clear: if Harbor Quill reaches 2,000 active users, I think Stripe Atlas would probably be the best choice. I am also unsure whether there will be at least 500 non-crypto buyers, so I don't want to incur the extra cost and burden before they become necessary.

From what I found last night, geoblocking is irrelevant under policy 39 because the business is officially based in Portugal.

Another theoretical route would be to establish it in Singapore because I have local identification, a passport, and a bank account there. However, that approach may introduce tax risks and complications.
